#C236196003Sakura#CDEF is right.

Apocalypse Now!
Come back soooooooon!

Surely you aren't thinking of WALKING back?
Do you intend to make me march for no purpose?
Look for that #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF!

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest.

Obtained
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.
Obtained
I guess to #C236196003Jinako#CDEF, this is her "comfy space"…

Don't. …like I just told you,
you can't get this #C000246204SG#CDEF unless someone dies.
No sort of brute force is gonna fly.
Stay here.

Why is he suddenly so desperate?
I'm a bit concerned.
UAAAAAHHHHHH!! JINAKOOOO!!! WHERE ARE YOU!!!?
GOD DAMN! WRONG PATH!!
Huh…? What is… this?

You hear me?
Once that number hits zero, you're a goner.
No resets allowed.

Got it?
I warned you.
Anything happens, it's your own dang fault.

Count… down?
Is this a curse?
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF is challenging me, isn't she?

…well, that aside,
please go about your business as usual, Darling.
…but to be honest, it wasn't really that big a shock to me.

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF said,
"We'll end up in the same place."
…let's look for #C236196003Jinako#CDEF.

A menacing #C236196003#SVT#CDEF draws closer to the
totally defenseless #C236196003Jinako#CDEF.

You said someone must die,
but then what happens to #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF's
countdown?
Hm…? Well, duh.
…old man…

After all the trouble he's been in after warning him,
he's going to try and tackle the Labyrinth alone, AGAIN?
And without a Servant.
A sore task!

…however, see how that grown man supplicates
us without shame. Let's turn back, Praetor.

Woah. That's our famously stubborn,
hotdogger-and-microwave-everything granny for
you! Yes, your concerns are understandable.

Wrong way.
Home's this-a-way.

Apocalypse Now!
Come back soooooooon!
Not yet.
I'm ready.
―――Wha?
Out with that "genius plan" you promised!
Wha―――!
Huh?

……
So, a lie?

To do that, I mustn't be occupied with
such trivial Labyrinth traps and enemies.

Come! To the pessimist #C000246204Sentinel#CDEF! We haven't
the leisure to stroll, for the counter above
our heads continues to fall!
Old man…?

We drag ourselves back to where #C236196003Jinako#CDEF is.
She even stuck around for us.

Hahaha.
The Earth had no such place where I belonged,
not anywhere.

Gross, you sideburns creep.
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF isn't a Christian or a Buddhist.

Precisely now that your creed is desperate,
consider praying to my resplendent god.
When one door is shut, another window opens!
…………(Praetor.)
……(Master?)
……(Darling.)
……(well, mongrel?)
―――But no genius can break THIS wall.

As a human being, not moving a
single step is to be expected.
Hmmm. I have to admit, it IS true.

It's pointless to chase after me.
Only death lies ahead. No killing.
Just simple death.
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF……!

Gah, poofing away AGAIN!?
Hold it, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF!
Ooooaaahhhhh!!!

Wai… #C236196003Monji Gatou#CDEF!
Don't go alone!
You WILL perish!

Oh…?
You see that guy?
He just ran off on his own.

#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.

After making a shortcut to the old school from
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF, please return to base.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that
you return for the moment to take a rest.
I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,
but I should #C000246204return to the old school#CDEF to
briefly speak with #C236196003Kiara#CDEF.

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort
out the situation.

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
That'll help move our search along.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
than I expected. Now would be a good time to head
back to the old school.
Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

After egressing from the Labyrinth's cemetery,
we saw a room. In that room is… #C236196003Jinako#CDEF… all alone.
#C236196003#SVT#CDEF surveys the space, but #C236196003Launcher#CDEF is
nowhere to be found.

We unexpectedly arrived at our destination,
yet again very quickly… or not?
The path continues further past here…

Aaand you've reached the goal.
Good job.

I'll tell you something as a reward.
The #C000246204SG#CDEF for this Labyrinth is "#C000246204Curse of Death#CDEF."

Without hesitation, she says something outrageous.
I barely had time to be startled before she continued―――

And I'll let you in on somethin' else, too.
If you want that #C000246204SG#CDEF, someone's gotta die.
Someone has to… die?

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF herself was feigning indifference.
Still, after firing her verbal bullets
through my heart, she loosed a bundle of
grenades on me with that too.

This is inexcusable.
I demand you correct that
arrogance of yours―――!

…ghh… Looks like you've admitted that
you've run out of ideas, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF.
Is this what a Game Champ would do!?

What's with that smug face!? Coercive-type
curses like that go right out the window once
you steamroll the hexer, oh yes!

―――Well, now. So anyone is fine?
Well then we have someone right here:
this roastable, female pig in front of us.

…this is bad.
I get why #SVT[she's][he's][she's][AUO is]# angry, but this is the one
shortcut to the end I don't want to take.

If we defeat #C236196003Jinako#CDEF without obtaining her #C000246204SG#CDEF,
the entire Student Council will be trapped
in the Far Side of the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF
and escape will be impossible…

This is certainly a condition we can't
simply ignore.

Do you impose the burden of this
"#C000246204Curse of Death#CDEF" upon all challengers
of the Labyrinth?

But if you were to get that #C000246204SG#CDEF, you would
presumably finish clearing the Labyrinth, so the
countdown should stop, right? Heck if I know.

Anyhoo, it's simple, yo～
No need to sweat the small stuff on this floor.
It's The Only Neat Tiptree I gots for ya.

Wha… That's not very funny.
Like hell we're going to accept a
requirement like that!

That's right. We can't possibly ignore this.
This is a plot by #C236196003BB#CDEF, taking advantage of
the characteristic of #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's #C000246204SG#CDEF.

Mhm! It just hit me!
One can lose a battle yet win the war,
and I've got the most GENIIIIUUUSSS IIDEEAAA!

A roar erupted in, as if to shatter the deathly silence.
It wasn't a Labyrinth signal;
it was a live voice reaching my ears.
―――But from where?

…it's too noisy, we're going to suspend―――
Actually, relay our signal.

It appears that #C236196003Monji Gatou#CDEF is visually
observing you from the vicinity of
the Labyrinth's entrance.

Huuh? H-how is he doing that?
T-that's incredible. Incredible, but scary.

Aye, good work, Treasurer #C236196003Rani#CDEF. I thank you.
That urna on your forehead isn't just for show.
Off to report to #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF now!

Unlikely to dial down his volume,
#C236196003Gatou#CDEF's transmission reaches me.

Sorry to bother you when you're busy,
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF! Do you hear me? Hm?
Too loud? Ohh, sorry.

Actually, I have a super-secret strategy this
time. I want to modestly instruct you on it so
very badly! Ah, basically, you know―――

I don't really mind this countdown stuff,
but those enemies wandering over there
truly are a tad scary!

Therefore, it's time for you to answer my
summons! Like the ever-descending gods and
Buddha do for me!

I would like for you to return to the
Labyrinth's entrance, posthaste!
Comeback, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF～!

…I've never heard such a blatantly caustic,
confidential conversation.
I involuntarily meet eyes with #C236196003Jinako#CDEF.

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF was scowling, fed up with it,
but soon simply shrugged with disinterest.

No matter what, that guy always gets real
persistent when the topic of #C236196003Jinako Carigiri#CDEF
comes up…

It's a bit baffling as to why he's so fixated
on an opponent he never fought, but if he says
he's got a plan, we have to hear him out.

A little dubious, isn't this?
Forget it, forget it. Let's ignore him.
I'd rather NOT have someone slowing us down!

…he's a boisterous man, but not a man to
spread meaningless claims. He IS a priest
of many good deeds, after all.

…everyone in the Student Council is likewise speechless,
probably unsure of what to make of this.

That said, it's not like I myself
have a solution, unfortunately…
Let's start by #C000246204heading back to the
Labyrinth's entrance and meeting up with Gatou#CDEF.

A "genius plan"… What is it, really, #C236196003Gatou#CDEF?
If it's a stupid plan you took three seconds to
make up, we'll turn you into shrimp chili.

But believe in me now, and entrust this to me
with the same sentiment as one who rides the
Titanic! It's three minutes until the iceberg!

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF looks up at #C236196003Gatou#CDEF with a blank stare.
#C236196003Gatou#CDEF does his thing and plunks himself down
on the ground cross-legged in front of her.

Mhm. At last, I was able to meet you in person.
Your expression really and truly
does look awful.

So naggy, man.
…you planning to lecture me?

Or do you just want to prove your worth by
showing how helpful you are? Looking for a place
to settle in the Student Council, old man?

I certainly did run around the world,
but the answer I sought was nowhere
to be found.

Diving into this Moon was my last hope, and
when I finally met with the truth, she said,
"yeah, there's no answer," and left.

No, she's planning to come back right away.
My waif―ahem,
my goddess is a merciful one.

After our single defeat, she unmistakably
forgave me by speaking the words,
"#C236196003Gatou#CDEF. Get to work." I think she said that.

Well, enough about me.
For the time being, let's talk about us humans.
I wanted to hear your voice.

And I'm even less interested in offering
your sketchy god anything, not even a single
tin of cat food. Dumbo.

If you sincerely object to even that,
then try complaining about something.
I never fail to clean my ears every morning!

I've BEEN telling you, man.
There's no such things as gods.
If any sort of a god exists, then it's…
Then it's "death," and that's it…

The only thing I can believe is heavy,
and it's cold enough to make
your fingers stick―the touch of death…

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF whispers low and glances sideways at me,
telling me to check the #C000246204Five Meditations#CDEF in my left arm.

But I reply by shaking my head.
I have yet to sense any indications of her #C000246204SG#CDEF.

Yeah…
There was never any sort of god…
That's because god abandoned me.

After all, it doesn't matter,
no matter where you go in this world,
it all belongs to the chosen geniuses.

Like you, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF. Don't tell me otherwise.
…old man, you're a dummy, but you're a genius
when it comes to affirming this world, right?

―――Death is absolute.
It treats everyone the same. There are no
genius or mediocre beings in death's eyes.

There isn't anyone who doesn't fear death.
Which means there's nothing to blame me for.

#C236196003Jinako Carigiri#CDEF.
Try talking to me about the #ROFS-002#RUBS origin#RUBEcause#REND of your rage.
I'll absolve you of your sins, all in one go.

I don't get what you mean. A worthless monk,
saving a totally worthless person?
Doesn't make one pixel of sense.

Isn't this enough?
I don't want to speak another word.
You gave me plenty enough company, right?

#C236196003#NICK#CDEF, #C236196003Gatou#CDEF, you won't be spared. Not
the Student Council bunch, or the AIs, or the
NPCs. No one gets spared, anyway. NO ONE.

Our destiny here is to turn into
Spiritron foam and disappear.

Hey! #C236196003Gatou#CDEF!
It's too risky to go in alone!

Leaping before he thinks?
For a man of religion, he's intense, isn't he?

Once again, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF slipped away further
into the Labyrinth.
And we're losing sight of #C236196003Gatou#CDEF now that
he's chasing after her.
Our problems doubled out of nowhere…

There still hasn't been any #C000246204SG#CDEF reaction.
I wonder if we should really keep going deeper in.

…Praetor. Concern for others is good and fine,
but don't forget about the
curse suspended over your own head.

…I-I guess I can sympathize though.
We mustn't leave those two to their
own devices, even if together.

…now that it's come to this, I assume #C236196003Jinako#CDEF
will throw all the resources she has left into
the Labyrinth and send enemies at us.

That countdown shouldn't pose any issues.
Let's stay focused and go in.

…well, I doubt that we'll run into any
trouble wherever Monji was able to reach
empty-handed. That man is oddly lucky.

What's in that head of his, I wonder…
I would kind of like to go back to My Room
and have some tea and cakes right now, but…

Darling…
You don't look like you want to wait a
while to see what happens. I understand.

There was no place where he belonged, he said?
I can't discern his intentions, but that #C236196003Gatou#CDEF
goes straight for the core, doesn't he?

We'll pursue, mongrel.
This is the Labyrinth's terminal, at last.
Let's go see how that commoner struggles.

Now #C236196003Gatou#CDEF shows up. Looks like he evacuated temporarily.
Was he always this wise―no, have this much sense?

Good to see you again. I just dropped in
myself. Oh, I'm serious, I'm serious.
I wasn't waiting, not at all.

But hey, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
I know I'm the one that called you here,
but don't you feel tired?

In the manner of Jizo, I shall wait here.
Stopping by the old school to prepare
isn't a bad choice.

Once I make my move, my cataclysmic
grand strategy will go off instantly: EXPLOSION.
No doubts, I'm going in. That kinda thing.

If you need to mentally prepare before that,
do some shopping, or consult #C236196003President Leo#CDEF,
then you should go get it all out of the way.

…although he's oblivious,
#C236196003Gatou#CDEF is always capable of thinking about others.

I think taking his advice
and going to back to the old school would be fine.
Return to the previous floor?
Return to previous floor.
Return to the old school.

Oh boy… At this rate, we'll have to save every
Master at least once, won't we?

Ugh, and it's the obvious punchline…
Wait, he's already running ahead!?

Hmph, what an exemplary fool.
He may be unsightly, but he's got conviction.
…Rani. Could you lower the volume a tad please?
I agree… Just what is Monji Gatou attempting to do?

Urrgh, damn enemies! I don't have the time to
set you on the right path today!

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

Want to kill me and find out?
If you're fine with it, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF,
then it's no biggie to me.

…there's no way I can answer her provocation.
Let's meet up with #C236196003Gatou#CDEF by the Labyrinth's
entrance and give his genius plan a shot.

Shown on the displays are BBSs and aggregator sites.
Carelessly left about are manga, games, junk food and stuff.
This is the only place here that looks like
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF's room back in the old school.

Can't go further in until somehow dies, anyway.
Ever consider giving up?
Is everything in order?

Very well, there's no rush. To be honest,
I need to mentally prepare as well.
Take your time, then come back.

Good. Then let our charge commence.
I hereby place my humble life in your hands.

#C236196003Gatou#CDEF immediately heads off into the Labyrinth.
Like what a mother cat does,
his stride might just pick us up and pull us along by the neck.

Hold on. Before we go, tell us of the
repercussions and promise of your proposal.
In words we can understand.

What happened to your "genius plan" or whatever,
#C236196003Gatou#CDEF? Don't tell us you accidentally hit
your head on a wall and forgot?

Hold a moment, you boar-monk!
What manner is this, rushing straight in!?

What of that "genius plan"?
Do you have knowledge of an art that
transcends death, #RUBSwandering monk#RUBEShramana#REND?

―――That's right.
Just what IS this idea you invited me to hear?

Yes, about that… Forgive me.
I have no such thing.
That was my means, as in, to justify my ends!

W-what the hell is this old man spouting!? Does
this look like the time to be telling jokes!?
Is he just full of hot air!?

――――His statement went so far that even #C236196003Shinji#CDEF,
who isn't even in the Student Council Room, chimed in.
…looks like he WAS peeking in on us from somewhere.

Mhm. I'll dutifully accept your ire.
However, I, #C236196003Monji Gatou#CDEF, must use any
means necessary to meet #C236196003Jinako#CDEF.

#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF. #C236196003#SVT[Lady][Sir][Lady][Sir]# #SVT#CDEF.
I apologize, but I request that
you indulge my selfishness.

And whose fault is that… is a question I had
no time for, as #C236196003Gatou#CDEF pushes forward―
No ifs, ands, or buts.

Not much we can do about it.
We'll just have to go back to the room #C236196003Jinako#CDEF was in.

A skull and crossbones abruptly appears above my head.
This is ominous. It doesn't get more ominous than this.

So that there is a countdown.
To your end, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.
Your death sentence.

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF voice echoed throughout the Labyrinth.
It should just be a regular transmission,
but it sounds ominous, like she's satisfied with herself.

The Sentinel of the Labyrinth's voice
wanes and grows distant.
An indescribable gravity lingers in its trail.

The number displayed here is
certainly ticking down with each passing moment…
Is this a "Time Attack Floor"…!?

No… even if there is a time limit,
why are there so many digits…?

If it's by the second, then we have plenty of time.
If I go about this poorly I'll have months…
Wait, won't this take years?

Wow. You're quite skilled to be able to read
numbers over your own head. I want to try riding
on your head, too. A little bit.

Ah, yes, all jests aside―――
So, digits of death? That's rather morbid.
I hate both pain and death!

Fortunately, these digits are as languid
as a sleeping hippopotamus… That said,
I'm still reluctant to press on.

She's being selfish, as usual.
Just what is #C236196003Jinako#CDEF trying to guarantee here?

If the Labyrinth's features provide a hint
as to how to extract an #C000246204SG#CDEF, then it doesn't
get any more obvious than this.
We won't rush; we'll keep exploring.

If you dig a pitfall, you better dig two!
I'm going to dig twice as far deep and swap
it right with yours!

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
I told you to humiliate yourself, but don't
expose me to flustered humiliation.

After all, something like this will naturally
make one panic.

You lot are always facing many ending
clocks. To be manipulated by immediate death is
to be toppled by your current predicament.

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF isn't acting flustered,
which distracts me from my apprehension.

Right now, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's state of mind is what has me concerned.
Like back with #C236196003Rin#CDEF and #C236196003Rani#CDEF,
her mind isn't working to remove foreign invaders;
it's working to reject them.

I don't know what she's trying
to tell me with that, but…
I can't leave this lying, lonely girl alone.
